declared_by: project owner (chat decision 2026-09-30), recorded before any step-5 tuning

evaluation_cohort.selection: seed 20260930, proportional phase-count strata, human quality score 1, accepted active refinement, development samples excluded

targets.denominator: all 200 cases; abstentions and failures count as not passed
targets.scoring: validation/wp5/phase_scoring levels 'family' and 'strict' as used by run_bundle (recall and precision thresholds from the frozen evaluation policy)
targets.reporting: point rates with Wilson 95% intervals, per phase-count stratum, abstention count

rules: The held-out cohort is not run, scored or inspected until parameters and code are frozen and hashed.
It is evaluated once. Any change made after seeing its results requires a new held-out cohort.
All tuning and development use the 100-case development bundle (frozen-100-v3), which is fully label-exposed.
